title: HealthSteps
description: data/running/owner/health-steps.yaml: known steps in a source's readings (FR-062a), such as a scale whose reference was reset by hand. Every reading of the metric from date on has shift added, so it joins the readings before the step; steps add up. Applied after exclusions and before any average is computed. List files carry no schema_version; they are always the current version.

shift.description: Added to every reading of the metric from date on, in the metric's unit: the earlier readings' level minus the later readings' level, measured once the source has settled.
